verses.text: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!

xrefs.text: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

verses.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

xrefs.text: Now, my God, may Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.
Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to all the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.

O Lord, may Your ear be attentive to my prayer and to the prayers of Your servants who delight to revere Your name. Give Your servant success this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” (At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.

verses.text: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?

xrefs.text: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin.
When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.
If I sinned, You would take note, and would not acquit me of my iniquity.

verses.text: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

xrefs.text: And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.
Let the wicked man forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and act, and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart— for You alone know the hearts of all men—

verses.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.

xrefs.text: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob. I will put my trust in Him.

verses.text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.

xrefs.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
Fearing that we would run aground on the rocks, they dropped four anchors from the stern and prayed for daybreak.
A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!

verses.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.

xrefs.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.

verses.text: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.

xrefs.text: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.
He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.
She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.
He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
